faq.question: How accurate is the AI photo parsing?
faq.answer: Our AI identifies 95%+ of common meals correctly on first try. If confidence dips below 70%, we show edit suggestions instead of forcing a result. You can always adjust portions or swap items in seconds.

faq.question: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.answer: You drop to the free tier immediately. All your meal history stays. You can still view past logs and log manually, just without AI parsing or macro coaching.

faq.question: Do you sell my data?
faq.answer: No. We never sell user data, period. Your photos aren't used to train our AI or anyone else's. Read our privacy policy for the full details.

faq.question: Is there a mobile app?
faq.answer: Calorisync is web-first and works perfectly on any phone browser — iOS Safari, Chrome on Android. No app install needed. It feels native on mobile.

faq.question: How does the free tier work?
faq.answer: Free users get read-only access to their entire meal history and can log new meals manually (by typing food name and portion). No AI photo or voice parsing, no chat macro assistant.

faq.question: Can I export my food log?
faq.answer: Yes. Pro users can export all meals as CSV anytime. Useful for sharing with nutritionists, importing to health apps, or backing up your data.

faq.question: What if the AI gets a food wrong?
faq.answer: Edit it in one tap. Swipe to change portion size, search to swap the item, or delete and re-log. Your corrections train our confidence model without uploading new photos.

faq.question: Do you support keto, high-protein, and other diets?
faq.answer: Yes. Pick keto, high-protein (for lifters), Mediterranean, or balanced. Your daily macro targets recalculate instantly. You can also tweak ratios manually.

faq.question: Can I use Calorisync offline?
faq.answer: Voice logging works offline and syncs when you reconnect. Photo logging needs a connection for AI parsing, but all your past meals and charts load instantly from cache.
